title: crypto2dev: test harness and simulator stub
description: Implement test infrastructure for the crypto2dev shim. Two components: (1) A minimal /dev/crypto2dev simulator that intercepts open()/ioctl()/write()/read()/close() calls via a compile-time shim (similar to caliptra_sim.c), allowing the test suite to run without the kernel module loaded. Simulator uses wolfCrypt software to implement the operations. (2) A test harness (wolfcrypt/src/port/crypto2dev/crypto2dev_test.c) with known-answer tests for each algorithm using NIST CAVP vectors and RFC test vectors — AES-CBC, AES-GCM, SHA-256/384/512, HMAC, CMAC, HKDF, PBKDF2, RSA-2048 sign/verify, ECDSA P-256 sign/verify, ECDH P-256.
notes: Test vectors must be independent of the code under test (NIST CAVP, RFC 5869, RFC 8018, NIST SP 800-38B). Simulator allows CI to run shim tests without kernel module. Real hardware path: link against actual /dev/crypto2dev (same code, different transport).
